Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your renewal offer and the cost context provided. In line with your approval requirements, please submit our price proposal to your pricing committee for approval; we also seek a longer agreement, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4580 units per year for 36 months, 13740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 427.22 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5870003 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-05 you quoted us EUR 412.74 per unit for this part; your new quote is 6.2% above it. Our should-cost estimate for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020). Our demand forecast for this part is up +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09). Producer prices DE: electronic components changed -2.3% from 2025-01 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2611@2025-01, idx:PPI-C2611@2025-10).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 13740 units, about EUR 5870003. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your review of our proposal, the price-reduction freeze and your willingness to discuss contractual terms. Please resubmit our revised price to your pricing committee for a decision; alongside that review, we propose focusing on payment terms, contract duration and call-off flexibility to establish a stable renewal agreement.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4580 units per year for 36 months, 13740 units in total.

3. Basis: Our orders for this part rose from EUR 400.19 to EUR 412.74 within nine months (po:4500013355-10, po:4500014465-10).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
